optimizedDescription.value: GetGraphHealth reports provider statistics, VCS and content freshness, fingerprint compatibility, and aggregate/workspace graph health.

optimizedContext.value:
# Get Graph Health

## Rules
- `GetGraphHealth.execute(input)` returns `GetGraphHealthResult`: all `GraphStatistics`, `stale: boolean | null`, `currentRef: string | null`, `fingerprintMismatch: boolean | null`; aggregate `state: current | stale | unknown`, `knownStaleSinceLastIndex`, stable reason codes, ordered workspace health (`name`, state, latch, `vcs|filesystem|hybrid`, reasons).
- Use `provider.getStatistics()` for availability; propagate provider busy/stale errors unchanged. No external lock helpers or caller lock-bypass. Input `config: SpecdConfig`, already-open `provider: CodeGraphProvider`, `codeGraphVersion`, optional workspaces; never open/close provider.
- Get current VCS ref `createVcsAdapter(config.projectRoot)`; `isGraphStale(lastIndexedRef, currentRef)`. `lastIndexedRef === null` → `stale: null`.
- If workspaces given + `stats.graphFingerprint != null`, parse stored fingerprint, effective graph config, call `detectFingerprintMismatch(codeGraphVersion, projectRoot, workspaces, graphConfig)`; otherwise `null`. `createGetGraphHealth()` returns stateless instance, all input per `execute()`.
- Report content freshness, backend schema/generation compatibility, partial-index state, coverage/reasons excluded, unsupported, parse-failed, partially indexed. `excluded`/`unsupported` terminal and visible but not incomplete; `parse-failed`/`partial` incomplete + non-current. Reasons aggregate only incomplete coverage.
- Assessment/stat/content-read/hash failure = unknown affected scope, never false mismatch/stale latch. No indexing; only refresh equal-content observations and atomically set monotonic workspace/global stale latches. Target absence result must show whether trustworthy stale evidence.
- Successfully indexed coverage record requires expected persisted file/document node same logical generation. Missing nodes, impossible counts, completed generation over empty/partial graph → `contentFresh` and `coverageComplete` false, non-current, `GRAPH_CONTENT_INCONSISTENT`. Excluded/unsupported records require no physical code node. Read-only graph content; diagnostics support reindex/recovery.
- Aggregate precedence `stale > unknown > current`; true aggregate latch returns stale without rescan. Transient failure unknown without latch mutation; project-wide derivation/input failure may be non-current without false workspace failure. Structured output keeps all workspaces; text only aggregate + non-current; no absolute workspace/VCS roots.
- VCS workspaces grouped by repository root: one normalized modified-path evaluation filtered effective visibility; excluded-only changes leave latches unchanged. Non-VCS compare visible membership/stored observations, hash only mtime/size differs, refresh equal content, stop first proven mismatch; inspection failure stays unknown unless independent stale proof. Never inspect all symbols or targeted resources graph-wide.

## Constraints
- Never trigger indexing, destructive recreation, arbitrary graph mutation, load changes, or compile project context.
- May mutate only semantic freshness cache: equal-content observations; monotonic workspace/global stale latches.
- Use already-open provider only.
